negative_choice: Euclidean distance from SAME person ENDPOINT center to nearest visibly different ENDPOINT body center, ties left then up; all selected negatives independently recomputed. Mixed endpoint boxes are allowed as a negative only when every occupant is visibly different from the followed person.
observation_scope: Scored observations are exactly the union of concrete pair endpoints. All raw164 source boxes are preserved separately; all83 starts have explicit review status.
source_coverage_notes: Seven explicit source-endpoint-miss start boxes represent eight visibly undetected people: three boxes/four people in40, four boxes/four people in50. This does not include merged/ambiguous source-box cases: those remain a separate category without inferred unique-person counts.
